name: @pipeworx/mcp-passwordgen

tools.name: generate_password
tools.description: Generate cryptographically-random password(s) (keyless, offline, CSPRNG). Control the character sets and length; returns the password(s) and their entropy in bits.

tools.name: generate_pin
tools.description: Generate a cryptographically-random numeric PIN (keyless, offline).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-passwordgen forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the passwordgen pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
